title: E-MTR-0032: explores whether the light register pair's extra quartic over its members fades for lighter, larger...
purpose: Experiment E-MTR-0032 in the spin arena: explores whether the light register pair's extra quartic over its members fades for lighter, larger pairs: the instrument fixed first (filter length 4096, a wide member-placed window, the lowest heavy line as the ground), then the quartic fraction at m 0.284 $a_B$ 8 and m 0.380 $a_B$ 10 with E-MTR-0031's m 0.284 $a_B$ 12, against each member's own band: fail on the instrument, the witness fixed but the moving level a multiplet at every K, so $a_B$ 8 has no read and m 0.380 $a_B$ 10 reads 3.21 +- 0.14 against its member's 2.41, an excess 0.80 above $a_B$ 12's 0.44, the way a lattice term would go, not toward relativity.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
